svg.title: How far published energies sit from the exact answer, by system size
svg.desc: Relative distance from the exact ground-state energy (x) against number of sites (y) for 401 published energies on 229 exactly solved instances.
svg.text: How far published energies sit from the exact answer, by system size
401 energies on the 229 instances that have an exact ground-state energy, each as its relative distance from that energy.
Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record, hollow ones cannot.
relative distance from the exact energy
Distance is |E − E_exact| / |E_exact|; 34 rows closer than 10⁻⁸ sit on the left edge. No line joins the sizes: the instances at one size are
different Hamiltonians, and a frontier across them would compare a Hubbard energy with a Heisenberg one. Exact references are exact
diagonalization or sign-problem-free QMC; flagged rows are not shown.
